# History rewrite of 2026-11-13: old-to-new commit map

On 2026-11-13 the history of this fork (cohnt/ik-net-optimization) was rewritten with
`git filter-repo --replace-text` to scrub a collaborator's API key that had been committed in
`notebooks/IiwaModel.ipynb` (2026-03-02, redacted at HEAD 2026-09-05). Every occurrence became
`***REMOVED***`; nothing else in any file changed. Four independent critics (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus,
Fable) verified that only the 135 commits carrying the key changed tree, by exactly that string.

**Commit hashes cited anywhere from before this date are pre-rewrite.** That includes CLAUDE.md,
docs, runbooks, results metadata, memories and commit messages. 20 commits older than 2026-03-02
kept their hashes; translate any other old hash (full or abbreviated prefix) with the table below.

## Two commit messages that still cite pre-rewrite hashes

filter-repo rewrites hashes quoted in commit messages, but cannot rewrite a reference to a commit it
has not processed yet (a sibling branch). These two messages therefore still cite old hashes:

| Citing commit (old -> new) | Cites (old) | Which is now |

| `aae4345` -> `754c861` | `ab6c56d` | `761ecd4` |
| `daabdc3` -> `fdbc0a6` | `c4e53a4` | `89bc84f` |
